data.name: Steal an Anime Egg!
data.description:
⚔️ Steal An Anime Egg!

How to Play:
🥚 Grab an Anime Egg from a boss’s territory.
🏃 Escape the chase and bring your egg back to your plot.
🐣 Wait for it to hatch and discover your anime fighter.
💵 Place your fighters on your plot to earn cash.
👟 Train on your treadmill to build speed and reach new areas.
🔧 Upgrade your treadmill and expand your plot.
📖 Explore different worlds and complete your anime collection!

🎮 Play on Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet.

data.name: [⛩️] Steal Anime Eggs & FIGHT!
data.description:
🥚Grab an anime egg and RUN! Escape the boss, dodge player traps, and bring your egg home to hatch rare anime!

🏃 Train on your treadmill to get faster  
🥷 Steal eggs from increasingly dangerous stages  
😈 Outrun the boss before it catches you  
👊 Watch out! Other players can steal your egg  
🪤 Place traps to freeze egg thieves  
🐣 Hatch rare anime with different sizes and mutations  
💰 Earn cash, upgrade your treadmill and plot, and take on the next boss  
💤 Your anime earn cash while you’re offline!

Stealing the egg is easy. Can you get it home?

🎮 Play on phone, tablet, PC, and console
